verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product rule builder where users define event-triggered actions. Webhooks only send HTTP POSTs to external URLs when chosen events occur. That is a developer building block for external automation, not a native rules engine. The "AI & Automation" feature heading is a bare label with no description of event-based rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
